subEvent.description: National Advisory Committee on Institutional Quality and Integrity - Pursuant to 20 U.S.C. 1011c, and the order of the House of January 3, 2025, the Speaker appointed, and upon the recommendation of the Minority Leader, Mr. Robert Shireman, Oakland, California, six-year term, and Ms. Dominique Baker, Wilmington, Delaware, six-year term.

Board of Trustees of the Congressional Office for International Leadership - Pursuant to 2 U.S.C. 1151(a), and the order of the House of January 3, 2025, the Speaker appointed the following member of the House to the Board of Trustees of the Congressional Office for International Leadership: Mr. Case.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE - The Chair led the House in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.
SPEAKER'S APPROVAL OF THE JOURNAL - Pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I, the Journal of the last day's proceedings was approved.
Today's prayer was offered by the House Chaplain, Chaplain Margaret Grun Kibben.
The Speaker designated the Honorable Glenn Thompson to act as Speaker pro tempore for today.
The House convened, starting a new legislative day.
